# pve_sdn_vnet (Resource)

SDN VNet (virtual bridge) configuration attached to a zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_vnet" "example" {
vnet = "CHANGE_ME"
zone = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) The SDN vnet object identifier.
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone this VNet belongs to.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias name of the VNet.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `isolate_ports` (Boolean) If true, sets the isolated property for all interfaces on the bridge of this VNet.
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `tag` (Number) VLAN Tag (for VLAN or QinQ zones) or VXLAN VNI (for VXLAN or EVPN zones).
- `vlanaware` (Boolean) Allow VLANs to pass through this vnet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: vnet (also the `terraform import` format).
